structure: CSharp WindowsLinker conditionally creates and links ole32 imports when the LLVM prefix declares CoInitializeEx. Both SLG native build paths list shell32/ws2_32/bcrypt without ole32. Registered COM activation uses CSharp context23 versus SLG context1.
branches: Windows COM versus non-COM and Linux; default/native-stdlib versus explicit native build paths; registered activation versus direct factory activation.
logic: COM imports must be derived from the emitted module before native linking. Registered activation must use the same class context as CSharp, while direct factory invocation retains its existing signature and path.
diagnostics: Current CSharp compile/link, llvm-as and closure passed. Current Native fails linking the same supported COM program due to CoInitializeEx/CoUninitialize/CoCreateInstance imports. Retained failed-stage LLVM independently shows class context1. No COM registry or runtime activation was executed.
